characters.description: A thin, pale, and exhausted student working at a diner to support himself. He is suffering from severe physical and cognitive symptoms, including tremors, blurred vision, heightened sensory sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. He appears to be under the care or surveillance of a clinic, where he is required to provide samples. He is described as looking like a ghost, with prominent bones and dark, hollowed-out eyes. He maintains a steady, calm exterior while working, despite his internal distress and physical weakness. He is hungry, tired, and feels vulnerable and exposed.
A male customer at the diner who sits in the corner. He asks Adrian if he is having a rough day and looks at him with curiosity and suspicion. He refers to Adrian as 'kid'.
A woman working at the reception desk of the clinic. She is described as having gray eyes and typing rapidly. She does not acknowledge Adrian as he leaves.

A woman associated with the clinic where Adrian is staying. She brings him food (water and crackers) and watches him eat silently. She appears to be an authority figure or caregiver in this context, maintaining a professional and observant demeanor.
